title: AP client station lifecycle + EAPOL/data RX - DESIGN ONLY, NOT FIRED by this lane
preconditions: fresh golden boot: page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, mask 0, staging 0
attended session with the recovery door READY (tools/recovery-card.sh) - recovery is physical, an agent cannot recover alone
bench link PASS (tools/bench-link.sh); harness never writes the UART (read-only captures only)
hostapd fixtures + the on-air observer from the earlier lanes are available (client = the observer host's station interface or a phone)
module params recorded before the fire; one module load per boot

base.tree: FINAL ALL-PATCH module (wifi-stability FINAL-INTEGRATION; stripped 308080 B sha256 5b5879497c169d6ab57dddd99487de5e69177621eeead64f5a137b31d2e70d41)
base.lane_patch: patches/0001-sta-ops.patch - not yet part of the fired all-patch artifact

module_params.common: fw_path=hi_wifi/FIRMWARE.PD4.bin wifi_block_path=<local block> allow_frames=32 frame_gap_ms=100 h2d_send_budget=10 vap_start_first=1 vap_start_mode=1 vap_start_module=0 hcc_poll_ms=5 hcc_trace=0 stop_ap_mode=0 mgmt_diag=0 rx_enable=1 beacon_static=1 beacon_vap_start=1 wpa_keys=1 wpa_key_module=0 sta_join=0 ht_mode=0 vht_cap=0 band_vendor=0 scan_band_cfg=0

rungs.name: host-only preflight (no fire)
rungs.purpose: prove the patch builds and carries the declared wire facts before touching the bench
pass: 0 warnings; 50 parameters; strip .text identical; artifact identity recorded
selftest 112/112 checks; RE tool all facts match

rungs.name: fail-closed control (sta_ops=0 eapol_rx=0)
rungs.purpose: prove the new ops never build/post/register-deliver when disabled
steps: insmod with the common params + lane_default
proven boot ladder, C2 ctx-create, iface __ap, hostapd WPA2 AP
let a client attempt association; capture dmesg
pass: AP-ENABLED as before; no sta_user_add/sta_asoc_syn/sta_kick frame post
dmesg: 'hi5622: .add_station reached - fails closed (sta_ops=0; ...)' once
hostapd: 'Could not add STA to kernel driver'; cfg80211_status shows sta_ops=0 eapol_rx=0
page golden, mask 0, no exception
fail_if: any g0 id7/id9/0x07d2 announce appears in the trace

rungs.name: enabled, no client
rungs.purpose: prove enabling the lane does not change the AP start (no early frames)
steps: AP start + hostapd WPA2 AP, no client
pass: AP-ENABLED; page golden; mask 0
cfg80211_status: sta_ops=1 eapol_rx=1 stations=0 user_add=0 asoc_syn=0

rungs.name: association -> hostapd STA added + firmware context
rungs.purpose: the core new hardware fact: .add_station posts the decoded per-STA context and hostapd proceeds
steps: start AP; from the observer, authenticate + associate with the WPA2 fixture (psk test-passphrase-121)
pass: dmesg: 'sta_ops: STA <mac> added (AID ..., vap 0, band 0): firmware context committed (g0 id7 user_add 180 B + g0 id1 cmd 0x7d2 asoc state 1)'
dmesg: frame post 'sta_user_add' (180 B, g0 id7) and 'sta_asoc_syn' (32 B, g0 id1) consumed with no retry
hostapd logs the station add (STA-ADDED) instead of 'Could not add STA to kernel driver'
cfg80211_status: stations=1 user_add=1 asoc_syn=1; allow_frames budget still > 0
page golden, mask 0, AP alive
fail_if: frame post refuses (budget/HCC gate) and hostapd reports the add failure
firmware exception / page-mask change (power-cycle, stop the ladder)

rungs.name: EAPOL/data RX probe (expected STOP: host data TX missing)
rungs.purpose: show the RX path is armed and expose exactly the remaining TX blocker
steps: observe hostapd's EAPOL-Key msg1 attempt (TX) and wait for the client's response
pass: cfg80211_status: xmit_dropped increments for hostapd's EAPOL TX (documented current limit)
no crash; AP alive; page golden
EXPECTED STOP: rx frames=0 because msg1 never reached the client - the peer-aware host->AP data TX lane is the next deliverable
fail_if: claim the 4-way works when no EAPOL was exchanged

rungs.name: (future, after the data-TX lane) 4-way EAPOL -> WPA2 PTK
rungs.purpose: complete the association: EAPOL msg1/msg3 out, msg2/msg4 in, pairwise add_key, authorized data
steps: requires the host->AP data TX lane merged and its own fail-closed proof
repeat L3 then let the 4-way run; watch cfg80211_status rx frames/eapol/delivered
pass: rx eapol >= 2 (msg2, msg4-like); rx delivered >= 2
add_key pairwise (cmd 0x0078, body 0x44, MAC = STA) posted; hostapd marks the STA authorized
dmesg: 'sta_ops: CHANGE_STATION <mac>: authorized=1'
post-authorization data (ping) delivered; page golden

rungs.name: station teardown (kick) and re-add
rungs.purpose: prove .del_station posts the vendor WAL kick and the station can re-associate
steps: from hostapd, deauthenticate the client (or let it leave)
pass: dmesg: 'sta_ops: DEL_STATION <mac> (... subtype 12, reason ...): kick committed'
frame post 'sta_kick' (WAL cfg-event opcode 0x00d0, 48 B) consumed
re-association posts user_add + asoc_syn again and succeeds; AP alive; page golden
fail_if: firmware exception on delete (stop; do not enable sta_user_del=1 on the same boot)

rungs.name: optional: sta_user_del=1 experiment (separate attended boot)
rungs.purpose: only if L6 shows the firmware user leaks / re-add fails: post g0 id9 user_del on del_station
steps: fresh boot; insmod with sta_ops=1 eapol_rx=1 sta_user_del=1
pass: dmesg: 'sta_user_del' frame post (24 B, g0 id9) consumed
no firmware exception (the E2 crash class is a double user_del)
re-add works
fail_if: firmware exception / page-mask change - power-cycle and record the negative result

rungs.name: soak
rungs.purpose: no new noise class from the station/RX additions
steps: 30-60 min AP with one associated client (after L5)
pass: no exception; page golden; counters consistent; no RX lane close
xmit_dropped only from the documented TX gap (or zero after L5)

abort_policy: ANY firmware exception, page/mask deviation, H2D lane close or post refusal that repeats: power-cycle, stop the ladder, record the rung
one module load per boot; never reload after the HCC ready handshake
sta_user_del=1 never runs on the same boot as a failed delete
recovery is physical: keep the RESET/TFTP door armed and a human at the bench
stop_rules: no retry after a refused post; the post path never retries by design
allow_frames budget exhaustion is a stop, not a reason to raise the budget mid-boot
the RX lane closes for the load on any anomaly - do not retry dp_rx_drain
